_why: FR-7: append preserves prior entries and call order, refuses set/append overlap, and protects append-only histories from replacement.

mutations.name: fr7-append-from-empty
mutations._mechanism: Building each append from an empty list silently discards every earlier entry.

mutations.name: fr7-append-reads-prior
mutations._mechanism: Reading the prior record instead of the updated record loses earlier appends to the same key within one call.

mutations.name: fr7-same-key-refusal-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Dropping the overlap guard permits a set and append on the same key to reach schema validation instead of the explicit conflict refusal.
mutations.find:
if key in fields:
            raise StateWriteError(f"--set and --append name the same key: {key}")
mutations.replace:
if False:
            raise StateWriteError(f"--set and --append name the same key: {key}")

mutations.name: fr7-append-only-drops-review-independence
mutations._mechanism: Removing review_independence from APPEND_ONLY lets a set replace the review history.

mutations.name: fr7-append-only-drops-implementation-authors
mutations._mechanism: Removing implementation_authors from APPEND_ONLY lets a set replace the authorship history.
